fixture.layout: 20 columns by 25 rows of axis-aligned dynamic boxes plus adjacent distance joints across the top row

fixedWork.broadphase: stable insertion-sorted sweep-and-prune on min-x; ties by body id
fixedWork.narrowphase: axis-aligned box overlap; resolve minimum-penetration axis; ties choose y
fixedWork.contactOrder: sweep order, lower body id first
fixedWork.jointOrder: ascending joint id after contacts in every solver iteration
fixedWork.velocityUpdate: semi-implicit Euler, strict f32 after every primitive operation
fixedWork.positionUpdate: mass-weighted horizontal contacts, stack-stable lower-to-upper vertical position and support-velocity projection, and mass-weighted distance-joint corrections, strict f32
fixedWork.stateQuantization: after every position-solver iteration and complete timestep, round x,y,vx,vy to the nearest 1e-3 using half-away-from-zero; this freezes chaotic cross-target evolution

oracle.completeState: all x,y,vx,vy values for every body at 300-step checkpoints and final state
oracle.quantization: round every state scalar to 1e-3 after each position-solver iteration and timestep using half-away-from-zero; checkpoint comparison still validates all stored f32 values

limitations: Axis-aligned translation-only Box2D-style solver; no rotation, sleeping, continuous collision detection, or warm starting.
This candidate does not alter the byte-frozen v1 catalog and is not accepted coverage until independent review and retained browser evidence pass.
No performance conclusion is recorded by this package or demo.
